result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out. The main visual defect is in the bottom navigation bar, where the system home indicator overlaps the search and saved icons. Secondary gray text on light backgrounds is also somewhat low in contrast. Clipped carousel items and cut-off cards at the viewport edges were treated as intended scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The black system home-indicator bar is drawn over the bottom navigation bar, overlapping the search icon and partially obscuring the saved/bookmark icon.
issues.suggestion: Reserve safe-area padding at the bottom of the navigation bar so the home indicator sits below the nav icons rather than on top of them.

issues.description: Secondary gray text (search placeholder, delivery fees, and time/meta labels) appears low in contrast against the white and light gray backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet at least WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 for normal text).
